# E0617: this thema was built without the playground

thema serve playground serves the playground built into this thema, and this
one was built without it. The help says how to build it in: the bundle is
generated, then embedded under the playgroundui build tag.

thema reports:

```
error[E0617]: this thema was built without the playground
  |
  = help: build it in: go generate ./cmd/thema/playground && go build -tags playgroundui ./cmd/thema
```
